up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human target CHEMBL1856 (3-oxo-5-alpha-steroid 4-dehydrogenase 2). The query must include: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Constraints: 1) Filter for exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. 2) Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. 3) Limit to 1000 rows. 4) Ensure the target is associated with the molecule via the activity record.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id AS "tax_id", cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", a.standard_type AS "standard type", a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1856' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
